final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Attività scolastiche'
  AND surface_area >= 180
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
  AND mobility >= 71
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: APE energy class C or better, as requested by the user (preferred, not mandatory). The gross floor area (at least 180 sqm), capacity (14 people), and proximity to public transport are not energy-related columns and are outside this agent's scope.

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 180. The requested capacity of 14 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied.
The user wants the building located near public transport. Mobility 75th percentile is 70.93, rounded to 71.
